proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. The surface only supports spell | class_feature | mastery. A MagicItemRecord type and corresponding mechanics family are required before any magic item can be encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Ammunition, +1, +2, or +3 is tagged Weapon (Any Ammunition) — a magic item, a unit kind with no record shape in the current surface.

proposed_widenings.name: rarity axis in LevelAxis
proposed_widenings.justification: The +1/+2/+3 bonus is determined by rarity (Uncommon/Rare/Very Rare), not by character level, class level, slot level, or proficiency bonus. LevelAxis has no rarity member.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition.

proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_consume trigger for UseCountResource
proposed_widenings.justification: The ammunition loses its magic when it hits a target — a single-use-per-hit consumption trigger. RestResetCadence models rest-based refill; it has no variant for 'consumed on hit' or 'destroyed on use'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

notes: The unit kind (magic_item) is absent from UnitRecord — structural widening, not surface or atom widening. The core mechanic (modify_roll_numeric on attack and damage rolls) maps to existing v4 atoms cleanly; the blocker is the missing record shell. Two secondary gaps also exist even if the shell is added: no rarity axis in LevelAxis, and no on-hit consumption trigger in the resource model.
